record.dic_text:
050 'Abiyshuwa` {a-vi:-shu:'-a}

源自 SNH00001 和 SNH07771; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Abishua 5; 5

亞比書 = "我的父是拯救, 或是富足的"
1) 非尼哈的兒子, 亞倫的曾孫
2) 便雅憫族, 比拉的兒子 (#代上 8:4|)

050 'Abiyshuwae {ab-ee-shoo'-ah}

from 01 and 07771;; n pr m

AV - Abishua 5; 5

Abishua = "my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence"
1) son of Phinehas, grandson of Aaron
